panels.description: An amber signal pulses through Keel's pump hall, rail gate, Halyard and Oasis. Keep infrastructure dominant and leave upper space.
In an Oasis control room, Mera reads the legacy alert. Leave upper display space.
Mera aligns a glass of water with her desk edge, then stops correcting it. Leave upper desk space.
A cold tracking ring closes around the amber signal moving toward Site 6. Leave upper control-room space.

items.text: LEGACY PROTOCOL DETECTED — SOURCE: KEEL SECTOR.
